def annotate_sentence(sentence):
    """Identifies and tags entities in a sentence."""

    tags = []
    words = sentence.split()
    i = 0
    while i < len(words):
        word = words[i]
        if i + 1 < len(words) and word == "ll":

            i += 2
        elif i + 1 < len(words) and word == "'s":
            tags.append("POS'")
